title: Rainbow Party Ghosts
note: Watercolor rainbow stripes and bright dot-painted confetti throw a party behind a friendly paper ghost with rosy cheeks and a happy smile.

title: Tim Burton Self Portrait
note: Shaded in pencil on black paper: a big-eyed self-portrait with spiky hair, a stitched-on grin and a bow tie, in a spooky-fun Tim Burton style.
